camera.shot_scale_bias: close handheld shots that reframe constantly

lens.dof: moderate focus that hunts slightly as the subject moves

sources: whatever room lights are already on
lighting.practicals: no added lighting, so windows blow out and corners go muddy

rules: heads cropped by the frame edge
composition.movement_of_subject: the subject moves unpredictably and the camera scrambles to keep up

sound.ambience_bias: raw location sound with room echo, clothing rustle and off-camera noise

must_include: the camera is handheld and visibly unsteady
the framing is imperfect and corrects itself during the shot

notes: Available light, handheld camera, no score. Imperfection is the point; the music fields resolve to N/A unless the user asks otherwise.
